rates.title: Customer shipping rates
rates.description: What customers pay per zone or postcode and weight / volume band, VAT-exclusive. Changed as versions, approved by C-Level and applied from their date — never back-dated.

zones.title: Shipping zones
zones.description: The zone scheme of each rate card and the postcodes of each zone.

carriers.title: Carriers
carriers.description: The factory's own fleet by default, and the fallback carriers Packio books where a factory cannot serve a zone.

calendar.title: Business calendar
calendar.description: National holidays and extra working days every factory shares, used for lead times and SLAs.

editor.caption: Rates of this version
editor.duplicate: Copy line {n} as the next band
editor.noLines: No rates yet — add the first line.
editor.hint: Bands run from (inclusive) up to (exclusive); an empty up-to is open. A postcode line overrides its zone. Amounts are VAT-exclusive.

errors.overlap: band overlaps another line of the same zone

rates.empty: This version has no rates yet

version.label: v{no}
version.title: Version {no}
version.editIntro: Saving replaces every rate of this draft. Fix the marked lines first.
version.fixLines: Fix the marked lines before saving.
version.importIntro: Upload an .xlsx file (sheet rates). Every row is checked first; confirming replaces the draft's rates with exactly what was checked.
version.importNotReady: Not ready — upload a file without errors first.
version.importHint: Columns: zone_code, postcode, weight_min_g, weight_max_g, volume_min_cm3, volume_max_cm3, price_amount, per_extra_kg — an export of an earlier version is a ready template.
version.previewReplaces: Confirming replaces every rate of this draft with this file.

customer.noCard: There is no customer shipping rate card yet.
customer.versionsIntro: Choose a version to see its rates. A draft is edited by its author; a submitted version is frozen.
customer.newVersionTitle: Draft a new customer rate version
customer.newVersionIntro: A version is a complete set of rates: copy an earlier one and change it, or start empty to import from Excel.
customer.effectiveHint: Applies once approved; approved after this date, it applies from the decision.
customer.reasonRequired: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.

submit.title: Submit version {no} for C-Level approval
submit.body: Its rates freeze once submitted; approved, it applies from its date. One version can be in approval at a time.

withdraw.title: Withdraw version {no}
withdraw.body: Its approval request is withdrawn with it; the version in force stays.

delete.title: Delete draft version {no}
delete.body: Only your own draft can be deleted. This cannot be undone.

quote.title: Try a quote
quote.intro: What a customer would pay for one parcel, on the version in force on the chosen date — a check before submitting.

miss.no_rate_card: No rate card in force on that date
miss.zone_unknown: The postcode is in no zone

zones.title: Zones
zones.schemeHint: customer_default is used by customer rates and factory payouts; the others belong to carriers.
zones.codeHint: Letters, digits, ., - and _, e.g. bkk or north-1
zones.incomplete: Fill in a valid code and both names.
zones.addSchemeIntro: A scheme for a new carrier, e.g. carrier:flash_express
zones.postcodesIntro: Paste postcodes separated by new lines, spaces or commas. A postcode in another zone of the scheme moves here.

carriers.fleetIntro: The factory's own fleet, the default way goods travel. What factories are paid is set on each factory's shipping payout tab.
carriers.fallbackIntro: A fallback carrier Packio books where a factory cannot serve a zone, on Packio's account.
carriers.addIntro: Only the Secrets Manager reference is kept — never passwords or keys. The previous active account of the same environment is closed.
carriers.label: Account label
carriers.secretRefHint: e.g. packio/carriers/flash/production (a JSON of the credentials)
carriers.incomplete: Fill in the label and the secret id.
carriers.testIntro: A real quote on Packio's account, to check the account works.
carriers.delivereeHint: Deliveree needs coordinates for both places.
carriers.testIncomplete: Fill in both 5-digit postcodes and a weight.
carriers.deactivateBody: The account is kept for history and no longer used.

calendar.title: Holidays {year}
calendar.name: Name
calendar.observanceHint: Only days observed by everyone stop lead times and SLAs.
calendar.addTitle: Add a day to the calendar
calendar.formIntro: Replaces the day if it is already there. Due dates already computed do not move.
calendar.incomplete: Choose a date and give a name of at least 2 characters.
calendar.removeBody: The day becomes an ordinary working day. Due dates already computed do not move.
calendar.emptyHint: Add days one by one or import the whole year from Excel.

factory.auditNote: Factory payouts are cost data: every read is audited, and suggestions are never shown to the factory.
factory.noVersions: No shipping payout for this factory yet
factory.noVersionsHint: Draft a first version over the customer_default zones and send it to the factory to accept.
factory.newVersionTitle: Draft a new shipping payout version
factory.newVersionIntro: One draft or version awaiting the factory at a time; it applies once the factory accepts every line.
factory.reasonRequired: Give a reason of at least 3 characters.

basis.no_customer_rate: No customer rate for this band

factory.answerTitle: Answer the factory's counters on version {no}
factory.answerIntro: Take the factory's figure, or keep ours for the factory to answer again. The version applies once every line is accepted.

send.title: Send version {no} to the factory
send.body: The factory sees it and accepts the whole card or counters line by line. Once sent, it changes only through answers.

withdraw.title: Withdraw version {no}
withdraw.body: It closes without applying; the card in force stays.

delete.title: Delete draft version {no}
delete.body: Drafts only. This cannot be undone.
